Who Funds the AI Safety Watchdogs

Funding pipeline analysis; METR diversification; Redwood revenue volatility; ~$25M Open Phil to Redwood historically. Cited from a search snippet; not re-fetched in full.

Signals citing this source

  • METR, F (for): Funder base widened beyond the effective-altruism network, including Pew Charitable Trusts.
